name: cargo-semver-checks
description: cargo-semver-checks — check Rust crate API changes for semver compliance. Detects breaking changes in public APIs.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/obi1kenobi/cargo-semver-checks/releases/download/v0.47.0/cargo-semver-checks-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && tar xzf cargo-semver-checks-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && sudo mv cargo-semver-checks /usr/local/bin/ && rm cargo-semver-checks-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

commands.description: cargo-semver-checks — check Rust crate API changes for semver compliance. Detects breaking changes in public APIs.
